threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep calling it the Overground instead of just the 'train'—everyone here knows it's just part of the commute.
Last Saturday on the 208, a bloke in a dinosaur costume argued with the driver about bus fare. Never thought I'd see a T-Rex at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a toddler arguing with a street artist over the best spray paint color on a Sunday afternoon at Herrfurthplatz.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab joint open at 5 AM that serves as the last stop for the club crowd, complete with an outdoor dance floor.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows not to flinch when the Muni stops for 'maintenance,' letting a dog off the tracks. Tourists just stare, puzzled.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the 5-Fulton, umbrella in hand, while a dog casually strolled along the tracks. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just waltz into a vermut bar and order a sangria, but locals know the real drink is a 'vermut amb llimona' on a Sunday.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the ferocity of the ferrets in the Park Güell fountain. Locals just dodge them like pros.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still don’t know the proper way to pronounce 'Kingsland Road.' Everyone’s looking at you like you just stepped off the tube from Zone 6.
Caught a late 196 bus from Brixton and witnessed a guy passionately arguing with a lamppost. Seemed like it was a long-standing feud.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a flock of parrots squawking in the park while the kebab shop was blasting '80s pop. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you see a guy selling homemade vinegar at a flea market while artists paint the walls of a former bakery. Pure Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their indifferent shrug when a Muni stop is dubbed 'delayed due to dog on the tracks.' It’s just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy dressed as a dinosaur trying to coax Muni to hurry up at Civic Center. Only in SF do we mix public transit with Jurassic Park.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think all the locals are always at the plaça for vermut. Most evenings, it's actually just the stray cats lounging there.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still trying to find the café that serves a decent cappuccino—most locals just go for cortados.
